items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Marlow; the interviewer mentions 'Manuel, Marlow' in the context of an old picture, and the interviewee responds only about visibility/glasses.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's the Chink on Tuba, Manuel, Marlow, and I don't know who. I believe that. Yeah, that's a chink, yeah. Yeah, that's the, that's a long time ago, too. That's an old picture. That's the picture like was in that book there. And there's where they come and gave him the record, you know. Who's that, Larry? No, who is that old fellow that you, from Biloxi? You don't remember him? He's dead now.
I can't see. Maybe even with glasses. Should have brought a big magnifying, maybe a big magnifying glass to the open, do you think, sometimes? Yeah, maybe. Yeah,
